thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — ELB 5xx and connection errors observed in us-west-2b. 5xx rate spike >= 18% over baseline for the last 3m. Affected target group: tg-prod-web-usw2. Auto-remediation attempted but errors persist. Incident channel opened.

Alex K: ack-ing, I'm oncall for infra. Pulling metrics now.

Jason L: looking at EC2 console — seeing ENI attach/detach errors and RX packet drops in us-west-2b. Kernel logs from some instances show repeated 'device eth0: disabling tx' around 02:11 UTC.

Priya S: confirmed from runtime side: our serving nodes in us-west-2b are returning intermittent 502/504 and some TLS handshakes are failing. Embedding-serving and chat-serving both affected.

Alex K: quick checks:
- curl against ELB from inside VPC: 502 consistently
- some instances show high drop in network bytes in/out
- CloudWatch: NetworkPacketsIn anomaly on eni-0a1b2c3d 

Alex K: Immediately shifting traffic off problematic targets. Following runbook 'elb-az-failover':
```
# deregister targets in us-west-2b
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456789012:targetgroup/tg-prod-web-usw2/abcd1234 --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d4e
# lower weight for Route53 traffic policy for us-west-2b
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123456 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"prod.example.com","Type":"A","Weight":10,"SetIdentifier":"us-west-2b"}}]}'
```

Priya S: good. also enable read-only fallback endpoints in us-west-1 for critical paths while we stabilize.

incident-bot: ACTION — traffic-shift executed by Alex K at 02:18 UTC. Health checks show target count reduced in us-west-2b from 12 -> 2 (draining). Error rate across prod down to 3.5% within 8m after change.

Maria G: CS here — which customers were impacted? We saw alerts from three largest tenants. Need a short blurb for CS to send. Numbers?

Alex K: preliminary impact: approx 7% of overall requests returned 5xx during spike window (02:08-02:20 UTC). Top affected tenants: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma, tenant-zeta. We'll provide logs + request ids.

CS Liaison: I'll start outreach for the top two and prepare status updates. ETA for initial message: 02:40 UTC.

Jason L: digging deeper — AWS ASG logs show repeated failures to attach ENIs in us-west-2b with error code EC2:InsufficientNetworkCapacity in that AZ for a subset of instance types. Opening AWS support case now.

Alex K: noted. If AWS reports AZ-level networking degradation, we'll keep us-west-2b at reduced capacity and maintain cross-AZ balancing. Also enabling extra capacity in us-west-2a/2c to absorb load.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-88421. Primary notified.

SRE Oncall: I'm taking the next 4h of watch. Handoff:
- Current state: traffic shifted, error rate down to 2.9%, us-west-2b targets draining, ASG scaling up in 2a/2c
- Open items: AWS support case for ENI/Networking in us-west-2b, route53 policy rollback once AZ healthy, follow-up with Eng to review instance types
- Contacts: Alex K (handoff), Jason L (platform), Priya S (runtime)

Alex K: handoff notes posted in /incidents/PD-88421. Key logs:
```
[02:11:04] instance i-0a1b2c3d: dmesg: eth0: disabling tx
[02:12:22] ELB tg-prod-web-usw2: 502 spike, 27% of requests
[02:18:11] runbook: deregistered 10 targets in us-west-2b
[02:26:40] overall 5xx back to baseline
```

Priya S: mitigation checklist for SRE Oncall:
- keep drained targets out of rotation until AWS confirms AZ is healthy
- ensure autoscaling in other AZs has warm instances (prewarm if needed)
- capture a sample of failed request IDs for postmortem evaluation of whether retries exposed stateful failures

Maria G: noted. CS will update affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: AWS case opened (case id 1234567890). AWS status: Investigating underlying EC2 ENI attach failures in us-west-2b.

SRE Oncall: scheduling post-incident review. Action items assigned:
- Jason L: escalate instance-type discussion with AWS and consider fallback instance families (due EOD)
- Priya S: add health-check adjustments to runbook to detect ENI-level packet drops earlier (due +3 days)
- Alex K: assemble logs and sample traces for CS and PM (due +24h)

Alex K: temporary rollback plan ready if error rate rises: reintroduce targets with graceful draining and enable regional failover.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-88421 acknowledged by SRE Oncall.

Maria G: thanks team. I'll sync with CS to prepare the customer note and share with legal for any SLA communications.

Alex K: marking incident as mitigated for now. Will leave channel open for updates from AWS and next steps. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: closing note — keep channel if follow-ups needed. Postmortem template: https://redwood.example.com/postmortems/PD-88421
